# Nure Asmir

> Nure Asmir is a Pakistani men's wear label — "Tradition in a modern form". Shalwar kameez, shirts, pants and leather accessories, delivered across Pakistan with cash on delivery.

Every product page lists the price in PKR, available colours and sizes, stock status and care details. Orders are confirmed by phone or WhatsApp before dispatch; cash on delivery is available across Pakistan and cash-on-delivery orders are reserved for 12 hours. International shoppers can view approximate prices in other currencies, but all orders are charged in PKR.
